config.privacy: amnesic until the person chooses to install; only a program granted the network capability can open a socket, and the Nym mixnet client is there for those that use it; no capsule can write to the serial console (a development image can); the kernel keeps its own console lines in memory for the Terminal's log; nsh.front listens on TCP 2222 only while the route is Direct, never through Nym or Anyone, and serves no one on a machine with no TPM or no enrolment
